Name: Animal Social Menu
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: A social menu for your animals.
Description:
**Animal Social Menu** adds a social menu for your animals. Check your animals' friendship values and if they need petting.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) and [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348) .

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Click the extra heart tab at the top of the in-game menu.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/AnimalSocialMenu/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
